Take a stool at the open counter, or follow a neighbor through the door. Both settle in for a bowl of ramen while the street carries on.

Opening the street.

About this preview

Three neighbors visit the shops among five passersby. One takes an outside counter stool; another enters through the sliding door and eats inside. Meals last about a minute, with little pauses between bites and a final two-handed drink of the broth. The door closes once the entrance is clear and reopens for departure. A third neighbor smells the flowers. The outside diner faces into the shop; her face, bowl and eating hands are hidden. The inside diner faces the street. This remains an animation study, with a locally layered entrance. The same resident artwork is reused; ordering, pulling the stool out, a varied cast, and real weather are later work.
